meta.title: Kairo — Productivity for CEOs
meta.description: The command center for leaders who execute. Kairo is the AI-powered productivity app built for CEOs, founders, and C-level executives.

hero.subtitulo: The command center for leaders who execute. Tasks, habits, agenda, and decisions — all in one screen.

features.subtitulo: No context switching. No endless tabs. Just execution.

tarefas.desc: Automatic prioritization, deadlines, categories, and voice creation.

habitos.desc: Build elite routines with daily tracking and streaks.

agenda.desc: Events and tasks in a single timeline. No conflicts.

ai.desc: Your personal productivity assistant. Suggestions, insights, and summaries.

equipa.desc: Collaborate with your team. Delegate tasks and monitor progress.

decisoes.desc: Record and analyze your decisions. Learn from the past.

precos.subtitulo: Start free. Scale when you need.

perguntas.resposta: Kairo is an elite productivity app for CEOs, founders, and executives. It combines tasks, habits, agenda, and decisions in one screen, with an integrated AI assistant.

perguntas.pergunta: Can I use it for free?
perguntas.resposta: Yes! The Free plan includes up to 10 tasks, 6 habits, agenda, goals, and decisions. Perfect to get started.
Kairo AI analyzes your tasks, habits, and agenda to provide personalized suggestions, productivity insights, and daily summaries.
Yes, you can cancel anytime. Pro access remains until the end of the paid period.

cta_final.subtitulo: Join thousands of leaders already using Kairo.
